standing: Leads the AFC East by 3.5 games

lastGame.title: Bills 31, Jets 12
stats: Josh Allen: 11-of-21, 196 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT; 2 rushing TDs (both 1 yard); passed Peyton Manning for most total TDs in a player's first 10 seasons
James Cook III: 18 carries, 157 yards, 74-yard TD run (career long, Bills' longest rushing TD since 2016)
DJ Moore: 4 catches, 90 yards, 45-yard TD; Dalton Kincaid had a career-long 54-yard catch
Defense: no TDs allowed, Jets 3-of-13 on third down; T.J. Parker 2 sacks, Dorian Williams first career sack
Jets QBs: Geno Smith 13-of-21, 148 yards before an ankle injury; rookie Cade Klubnik 11-of-20, 137 yards, 1 INT

news.b: Buffalo won its fifth straight and first AFC East game, 31-12 at MetLife. Joe Brady called it the team's best win so far, and he is the third NFL coach to win his first five road games in his first season.

CB Christian Benford (groin) and DB Dee Alford (concussion) were ruled out in the fourth quarter. LB Dorian Williams left with a calf injury after 9 tackles and a sack. WR Keon Coleman was checked for a concussion and cleared to return.

news.h: Defense hasn't allowed a TD in 33 drives
news.b: That is the NFL's longest active streak and the Bills' longest since 1999. The Jets reached the Buffalo 20 twice and settled for four Jason Sanders field goals.
Miami (1-8) visits Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS. Dolphins QB Malik Willis is on injured reserve (groin), and Kyle McCord was named the starter in his place.

source: buffalobills.com recap, takeaways and injury update (Nov 15); AP via ABC News and CBS Sports/Rotowire game notes (Nov 15); Fox Sports and CBS Sports standings, NFL.com Week 10 scores; CBS12 Dolphins QB report (Nov 10).
